purpose: Mechanical reproduction of recorded categorical states only; not validation of evidence, source-to-condition judgments, or historical truth.
scope: Private author-review packet only. No manuscript, repository, historical assessment, or released result is changed by this checker.

source.description: Authoritative final case derivation ledger; preserved byte-for-byte.

stages.interpretation: Preserves the historical recorded states and results without revalidation.

stages.title: Stage 2: limited original-framework corrections
stages.interpretation: Authority and propagation are unresolved P/I choices for each Patriot case. All other released cells are retained, not freshly validated. ZG710 Fail is conditional on retaining at least one non-propagation U.

rows.source_quote: Oko: P / P / P / P / P / P → Unresolved.
ZG710: P / U / {P,I} / U / U / {P,I} → Fail for every allowed replacement.
F/A-18C: P / I / {P,I} / I / I / {P,I} → Unresolved for every allowed replacement.

stages.title: Stage 3: full amended proposal, conditional and unadopted
stages.source_section: Stage 3D Conditional aggregate and retained-failure alternatives
stages.interpretation: Requires adoption of evidence, construct and boundary amendments and all row-level judgments. Author approval has not been given. The three disputed non-propagation ZG710 U removals do not follow from propagation correction alone.

limitations: The checker tests arithmetic over supplied categorical labels; it does not validate the evidence, states, or historical source-to-condition inferences.
State sets are alternative assignments drawn from S/P/U/I, not a fifth state. Cartesian enumeration asserts no probabilities or evidentiary independence.
A U is decisive even if P or I occurs elsewhere. P/I cells block Pass only when no U is present.
No historical assessments are overwritten. Stage 3 and the labeled rule illustrations remain unadopted.
The frozen cutoff and source provenance are reproduced from the ledger. This package does not independently retrieve or authenticate the historical repository blobs or source evidence.
